verdict.rationale: replica-skill is a local Claude Code skill pack of SKILL.md prompts plus standard-library Python scripts that do not touch the network. It has no service, account system or API of its own for which an agent credential could be issued, so this story is a category error for the product. The mention of using "your keys" with Google's API refers to third-party keys the user supplies to their clone, not credential issuance by the product.
